verdict.rationale: Sill's docs state that only paired devices can connect, that every connection is encrypted, and that screen and keystrokes travel only between your own devices with no server, which implies end-to-end transport. However, the pack contains only the assertion and no documentation of the encryption protocol, cipher, or key exchange, which is the crux of this story. missing for 10: documented encryption protocol/cipher suite and key-exchange details, description of how pairing establishes keys, independent or hands-on verification of the encryption.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sessions are encrypted end to end with the protocol documented, not just asserted

citations.quote: After that, only the devices you paired can connect, and every connection is encrypted.
There is no account and no server: your screen and what you type travel only between your own devices
it shows a code for your iPhone or iPad to scan, and over a USB cable the two pair by themselves.
